# Offline update-test fixture

Unmodified m-bootloader installer and plain boot container copied from
`w0ts/fm1-base` commit `a3b5da168bc66ff41fc02b413c48e84f5f118709`,
`web/m-bootloader/`. MIT license retained. Used only by the fake-NOR OTA tests;
these files are not Audio Router release firmware or installation instructions.
Audio Router updates must preserve the installed bootloader.
